title: cyathea medullaris
intro: Cyathea medullaris, commonly known as the Black Tree Fern, is a species of tree fern native to New Zealand. This plant has been used in traditional Maori medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat wounds, reduce inflammation, and ease digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyathea medullaris include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of the Black Tree Fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
